content_of_post_to_comment: I’ve reached a point where I’m beginning to suspect the reassurances people give me about how “you’re still so young” might just be cope. Like I understand 27 is not that old by anyone’s standards other than Gen Alpha’s, but after hearing someone tell a 35 year old the same thing it’s starting to sound more like a generation’s collective denial that we’re now well into adulthood and have been collectively putting off attaining many of the milestones associated with adulthood.
comment: Maybe the issue isn’t that we’re delaying adulthood, but that the milestones themselves lost their shared meaning. A generation can feel “behind” when the map everyone inherited no longer matches reality.
